summary: Owned units s0133–s0154 contain no birth years and only two life-stage facts: Wang Xizhi’s 暮年 in s0149, and Wang Shu’s 母喪 in s0153. The qualitative age claim for Wang Xizhi is supported. Every other owned date is unsupported. The Shanyin Daoist, disciple, disciple’s father, fan-selling woman, and Wang Shu’s mother are given a fabricated source label 東晉永和前後 and a closed AD 353–355 window drawn from the Lanting year and Wang Xizhi’s later oath, not from these 嘗 anecdotes; 累年 in the Wang Shu episode also makes a 353–355 death for the mother too late. Zhong Yao and Zhang Zhi appear only inside Wang Xizhi’s (and Yu Yi’s) later comparisons; Cao Wei 200–230 and late-Han 168–192 are imported life windows, not their own dated events. Yu Yi, Xi Yin, and Yu Liang receive dynasty-wide career intervals that the chapter never states. Wang Shu’s attestation is labeled 永和十一年/AD 355, but that year in this biography dates Wang Xizhi’s grave oath; the Mu-emperor annals place Wang Shu’s Yang appointment in 永和十年 (conventional AD 354). Active hints copy the same invented endpoints and must not stand as living activity.
